hardcoded-color.description: Hex color literal in inline style or <style> block. If the hex matches a DS token's value, auto-fix replaces with var(--token-name). Hex with no matching token is a true brand violation and is reported only.

hardcoded-font.description: font-family inline or in <style> block referencing a literal font name. If the literal matches a DS font token's value, auto-fix replaces with var(--token). Must use var(--font-sans) or var(--font-mono) from DS.

orphan-class.description: Class used on an element that is NOT defined anywhere in the DS CSS. Either rename to a DS class or add the rule to the DS.

invalid-slide-background.description: <section class="slide ..."> missing one of the allowed background_classes.

invalid-slide-modifier.description: <section> uses an s-<name> class not listed in style_modifiers.

malformed-screen-label.description: data-screen-label is empty. The viewer prepends the global slide number at render — the attribute should hold just the human title (e.g. "Capa").

low-contrast.description: Text element's resolved color has insufficient contrast against its section's resolved background color. WCAG AA thresholds apply (see contrast_thresholds below). Detected via DS-aware resolution: bg-X class → background hex; cascade of `.bg-X .selector { color: ... }` + inline style → text hex; ratio computed via WCAG relative-luminance formula.

contrast_thresholds.comment: WCAG AA minimum contrast ratios. text_size_px = computed (or declared) font-size of the element being checked. large_text covers headings and any element flagged large by CSS (≥24px regular OR ≥18.66px bold).
